jobs.description:
The Consulting Business Line at Sopra Steria is a team of over 160 consultants in Belgium with extensive expertise in Digital Transformation. Recognized as a preferred digital partner, we collaborate with leading Belgian organizations across the Public Sector, Financial Services, and Industry. Our consulting services span IT Advisory, Architecture, Organizational Transformation & Change, Operational Excellence, Sustainability & Ethics and Innovation as a Service.  

Your primary focus will be client engagements, which will constitute the majority of your time. These engagements may involve working as part of high-performing teams embedded within client organizations or contributing to Sopra Steria’s fixed-price Consulting projects within multidisciplinary teams. 

As a Senior Consultant, you will take ownership of complex assignments, manage client relationships, develop and apply managerial skills, and support business development activities. On specific projects, your responsibilities may include project management, Agile/Scrum facilitation, business and functional analysis, or architectural design. 

 

 

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! 

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following:   

Experience: 3 to 6 years of professional experience in consulting. 

Digital Transformation: proven experience contributing to or leading digital transformation initiatives for clients. 

Areas of Expertise: demonstrated skills in one or more of the following domains: IT Advisory (Target Operating Models), Project Management, Business/Functional Analysis, Agile/Scrum methodologies, Architectural Design, ESG, or Product Management. 

Industry Knowledge: a solid understanding of business processes in one or more of the following sectors is an asset: Public Sector (Federal or Flemish Government), Financial Services (Banking and/or Insurance), or Industry. 

Certifications: recognized certifications such as Prince2, TOGAF/Archimate, Leading SAFe, or Lean Six Sigma are advantageous. 

Consulting Mindset: strong ability to build and maintain trustworthy client relationships, familiarity with business development approaches, and a strong connection to the Consulting "motherhouse".

Languages: you are fluent in Dutch or French, have a good understanding of the other language, and are also fluent in English.

Description:

Become a key player in for a growth client as an ERP Application Support. Leverage your technical expertise and knowledge of the glass industry to support our customers in their digital transformation.

 

Your responsibilities:

• Be the expert: Provide high-level support to our customers, helping them get the most out of our ERP solutions.
• Share your knowledge: Transfer your know-how to internal teams and customers, and help train new employees.
• 
Be an ambassador: Represent our company to our international customers and contribute to our development abroad.

 

Your profile:

• Industry expert: You have solid experience in the glass industry and are familiar with production, inventory management and logistics processes.
• Multilingual: You are at ease speaking and writing in French and English, and ideally speak a third language (Spanish, Italian).
• Adaptable: You are able to travel abroad and adapt to a variety of cultural environments.

Our client in Brussels is looking for a Software Architect to join their team.

This company is known worldwide for their GIS solutions for various sectors. In doing so, they help larger players, local governments, universities, map providers including NATO and Proximus with spatial analysis, map making and location intelligence to make better informed decisions. They also provide training and support to their customers in Belgium and Luxembourg. In doing so, they use the latest technologies.

To support their growth, they are currently looking for a Software Architect.

Some of your duties include:

• 
You lead the architecture and design of the GIS Foundation.

• 
You work with business, GIS and IT stakeholders to develop a GIS architecture that meets functional requirements.

• 
You design GIS environments with a focus on business continuity, deployment (on-prem/cloud), security, governance and application architecture.

• 
You define the technical methodology for implementation.

• 
You contribute to technical analyses, such as requirements gathering and gap analyses.

• 
You are responsible for design documentation.

• 
You supervise the project team and monitor compliance with the architectural design.
 

Profile

• 
Master's degree in computer science, geography, GIS or other relevant field.

• 
Experience as a Software Architect in GIS

• 
Excellent communicator who can brainstorm with clients and document solutions.

• 
You are fluent in English, Dutch or French and ready to become trilingual.

Build the integrations that power modern businesses

At Spector, we help companies connect their systems, automate processes, and unlock the full potential of their technology landscape. As an Integration & Automation Engineer, you design and build the integrations that make this possible.

You translate business needs into robust, scalable integration solutions and take ownership of projects from analysis to go-live. Working with Workato’s leading iPaas platform using modern integration patterns, you help organizations streamline operations and innovate faster.

Your responsibilities

• Design and implement complex integrations using Workato.
• Work with APIs, messaging technologies, and integration patterns to connect systems.
• Translate business requirements into technical integration solutions.
• Contribute to integration architectures (API Management, Data Integration, EDA, B2B).
• Ensure integrations are reliable, scalable, and maintainable.
• Collaborate with customers and stakeholders to deliver impactful solutions.

What we are looking for

• 3-4 years of hands-on IT experience.
• Strong knowledge of APIs (REST, SOAP, GraphQL).
• Experience with messaging technologies (JMS, AMQP, Kafka, etc.).
• Familiarity with enterprise systems (CRM, ERP, PIM, etc.).
• Professional proficiency in English.
Nice to have:

• Experience with Workato or other iPaas platforms (Boomi, MuleSoft, etc.).
• Experience in a consultancy or customer-facing role.
• Knowledge of business process automation.
• Dutch and/or French language skills.

We are looking for an Application Analyst & Support for one of our customers, a major player in its sector. You will be joining a dynamic team responsible for optimising and supporting business tools.

This role is ideal for an analytical, inquisitive and solutions-oriented professional with an affinity for technology and an excellent sense of service.

Your role will involve supporting applications, analyzing and testing new solutions, monitoring systems performance and contributing to their optimisation.
Your responsibilities will include

Support & User Assistance

Performance monitoring

Improvement & Optimisation

Acting as a key contact for suppliers on interface adjustments and tests.

 

Profile
✔️ Education: Bachelor's/Master's degree in IT, systems management or similar field.
✔️ Experience: Initial experience in application support, functional analysis or reporting.
✔️ Skills :

• Good analytical skills and excellent command of Excel.
• Ability to understand and optimise business processes.
• 
Good communication and service skills.

✔️ Languages: Fluent French or Dutch + good command of English.
✔️ Soft skills: Autonomy, thoroughness and team spirit.

Function

• Implementation and customization of SAP Business One based on client needs
• Analysis and improvement of business processes (purchasing, sales, inventory, production)
• Writing and executing SQL queries (read and write)
• Working both in a team and independently to meet client requirements
• Advising and supporting businesses in their digital transformation through ERP solutions

• 
Training and assisting users on SAP Business One

 

¨Profile

• 3 to 5 years of experience as an ERP consultant (ideally Odoo)
• Strong knowledge of databases and SQL queries
• Good analytical skills and a strong sense of responsibility
• Ability to work both internally and on-site at client locations
• Critical and constructive mindset, with a customer satisfaction-oriented approach
• 
Languages: Dutch and English is a plus

A UX designer sees software with a user’s eye, using design tools and principles to craft a distinctive, smooth experience for end users. Your interfaces will always be intuitive, engaging, and tailored to the user’s experience through collaboration with crossfunctional teams and relevant data. Your day-to-day will consist of developing wireframes and prototypes and conducting usability testing to refine designs. True masters of UX design understand both complex technical requirements and the user’s needs to translate them into designs that put the experience first. 

As a Designer, you will be instrumental in creating exceptional customer experiences through our tech solutions. Your expertise in user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) design will help you craft seamless, engaging experiences for end users. You’ll balance functional requirements with visually appealing design to meet both client and business objectives. Collaboration is key, so you’ll leverage your communication skills to work effectively across various teams. Staying abreast of design trends, maintaining a keen eye for detail, and addressing design challenges promptly will ensure that your solutions not only look impressive but also deliver outstanding results for our clients. 

 

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application!

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a relevant equivalent

Description

• Strategy: Developing and implementing IT strategies for the assigned area
• Management: Supervising teams, managing projects and optimising the use of resources.
• Technology: Evaluate and integrate relevant IT tools and infrastructures.
• Partnerships: Working with internal and external stakeholders.
• Solutions: Design and deploy IT solutions that meet the company's needs.

Profile

• Degree in IT or related field.
• 5 to 15 years' experience in IT project management.
• Proficiency in relevant operating systems and programming languages (Windows, VMWare, SAP, C#, .NET, SQL).
• Excellent communication skills (English, French or Dutch).
• Ability to solve problems and lead teams.
• 
Results-oriented and stress-resistant.

Your Responsibilities:

• Developing and maintaining Ruby applications.
• Participating in defining software architecture.
• Collaborating with an experienced team of developers.
• Contributing to the continuous improvement of development processes.
 

 

Your Profile:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
• Proficiency in Ruby and the Rails framework.
• Experience with JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and SQL.
• Knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, Azure, Git, and DevOps (a plus).
• Good communication skills (Dutch and English).
• Team spirit, autonomy, and curiosity.

Your mission

At Manuchar we are transforming towards our state-of-the-art 2.0 platform and ERP plays a crucial role in this journey! At the moment we have around 40 different ERP-system and the goal is to move all affiliates to Microsoft Dynamics 365. This is a long journey that won’t happen overnight. 

We are therefore looking to onboard a D365 Technical Analyst to join our Commercial Off the Shelf team.

As Technical Analysts you are the technical lead from concept to delivery & acceptance. Translate the high level solution design into a technical architecture design & to coordinate the technical realization and delivery with the different technology teams in our Service Delivery organization. You map current client architecture with future architecture, develop and document the current and future technical architectures, challenge the feasibility of the technical solution, validate the software delivery and are responsible for all migrations & integrations. You will be responsible for a detailed outlining of the technical specifications of the proposed solution and ensuring follow-up throughout the rest of the project.

Other responsibilities are

• Coordinating technical kick-off sessions by providing architecture overviews and formulating recommendations
• Developing the technical architectures in line with the enterprise architect principals
• Analyzing impact
• Producing technical requirements, feasibility studies, software architecture documents, testing strategy recommendations and other relevant documents
• Ensuring that development standards and best practices are followed in order to achieve a performant solution
• Validating if the output of all product developments meets the technical architecture requirements
• Assist in migrating the existing interfacing with other applications
• Assist on inquiries about D365 data models, data relationship.
• Execute D365 build pipeline and releases (deployable packages, ssrs data sets….)
• Manage D365 environment through LCS

What do you need to be successful in your mission?

• You have 5 years of experience as a technical analysts in large implementation projects.
• You have hands-on experience with X++
• You have experience with providing technical estimates.
• You are credible and reliable & can influence and convince the organization with an in-depth argumentation and demonstration.
• You can visualize a problem from various angles.
• You are a dynamic team player.
• You are able to work in a fast-paced and quickly changing environment.
• You are fluent in English. Knowledge of Dutch, Spanish and Portuguese is a plus.

Talencia is looking for an Infrastructure Project Manager for one of our partner who is a company in the TOP 20 for Randstad in 2023 ! The main sector of this client is the logistic/transport.

You'll work within a multidisciplinary team supporting both the design and maintenance of high-availability IT infrastructure. This includes overseeing network, hardware, and cybersecurity architecture, as well as managing preventive and corrective maintenance in data centers and control rooms.

Your role :

• Lead end-to-end project delivery: requirements, planning, implementation, testing, and rollout.
• Manage scope, budget, timelines, quality, risk, and resources.
• Act as the link between customer expectations and internal delivery teams.
• Drive team performance and ensure value-driven results.
• Maintain documentation and ensure alignment with project governance.

Your profile :

• 5+ years' experience in project management or change management.
• Solid knowledge of IT infrastructure in high-availability environments.
• Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
• Structured, solution-oriented, and proactive mindset.
• Fluent in Dutch or French and comfortable in English.

Role

• Design and integration of high-performance, user-friendly interfaces
• Proficient in Angular, CSS, and frontend testing frameworks (Jasmine, Karma)
• Solid functional understanding of backend technologies (Java, Spring Boot)
• Desired knowledge of mobile development and publishing processes on Google Play and the App Store
• Design and develop intuitive, high-performance user interfaces
• Implement frontend tests (Jasmine, Karma) to ensure code quality and reliability
• Work closely with backend teams to ensure seamless integration of functionalities
• Optimize frontend performance and contribute to defining web development best practices
• Contribute to deployment automation (CI/CD) to streamline and secure delivery processes
• Participate in mobile app deployment and publication on Google Play and the App Store
• Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into concrete technical solutions 

Profile

• Significant experience in frontend development, complemented by a solid understanding of backend technologies
• Excellent command of Angular and CSS, as well as frontend testing frameworks (Jasmine, Karma)
• Proven skills in web integration, performance optimization, and cross-browser compatibility
• Strong knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, continuous integration (CI/CD), and Docker
• Assets: familiarity with Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, Portainer, Docker Swarm, and GitLab CI
• Languages: excellent command of Dutch and French (spoken and written); good reading comprehension of technical English

• Recommend resolutions and improvements

• Ensure security by design

• 
Resolve issues prior to and following testing

• Provide technical and application support (via internal ticketing system)

• Collaborate closely with internal teams and clients

• Solid knowledge of SQL (both reading and writing)

Vinçotte is the market leader in Belgium and offers objective and advisory services in inspection, certification, conformity assessment and training. Our team of over 1,500 professionals is committed to a safer and more efficient society. Our sector specialists understand the needs of customers perfectly and guide them along the way with advice and support. Aiming for results for multinationals, SMEs, self-employed persons and private persons is what makes our blood flow. We are looking for a Network Security Engineer (M/F/X) to join our team in Vilvoorde.

Ready to level up your career and secure the digital world? As a Network Security Engineer (M/F/X) you’ll be the go-to expert managing our network and security infrastructure – across our campus, datacenter, and Microsoft Azure environment.

What will you do?

• Take charge of our network & security landscape, both on-prem and in the cloud (Azure).
• Provide Level 2 support for complex IT network issues.
• Dive into IT projects related to your area of expertise.
• Work autonomously in an agile setup with a clear backlog and strategic focus.
• Help improve documentation and technical guidelines.
• Detect, assess, and fix security risks – you're our digital guardian.
• Manage and fine-tune spam filters to keep our communications safe.

Experience:

• You've already rolled up your sleeves in network and firewall management — think design, setup, config, upgrades — and you know your way around operational environments.
• You’re certified in Azure, have experience with it, or you're eager to dive in and grow into a true Azure pro.
• You’re ready to become our in-house expert on Microsoft Security tools — managing, fine-tuning, and pushing them to keep cyber threats out.
• You're curious about Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and see it as a powerful tool in building fast, scalable, modern environments.
• You believe solid processes are the backbone of great IT — and you embrace ITIL best practices to keep things running smoothly and smartly.
• You hold an IT bachelor degree and have 2-3 years of relevant experience in the following domains:
• Routing & Switching: Aruba and / or Cisco
• Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) : Fortinet, Check Point or Palo Alto
• Reverse Proxy : BlueCoat, Fortiweb or Azure Application GW
• SASE/SDWAN: CATO, Fortinet, zScaler or Pallo Alto
• Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) CATO and / or zScaler
• Cloud Networking & Security: Azure 
• Network Access Control (802.1X Wired/Wireless, RADIUS, TACACS, Guest Portals)
• Vulnerability management: Nessus, MS Defender or Qualys
• Network Detection and Response (NDR): Darktrace 
• Extended Detection and Response (XDR): MS Defender and / or Sentinelone, 
• Spam filtering: MS Defender, Barracuda or Cisco Ironport 

Personality:

• You don’t wait around — when something’s blocking the business, you jump in and fix it fast.
• You’re all about progress: positive mindset, always learning, always improving, and staying sharp on the latest tech trends.
• Agile is your jam — you thrive in sprints, love a good retro, and believe great things happen when teams grow together.
 

Languages:

• Dutch or French? Check. English? No problem — you’re fluent in the language of international teamwork.

Role
As a Data Architect, you will work for our client to design, manage, and optimize complex data structures and systems. You will define data strategies aligned with the organization’s vision, ensure data integrity and scalability, and establish standards for data governance. You translate stakeholder needs into technical solutions and provide clear documentation so that each stakeholder can understand the data model from their perspective. You embrace innovation by implementing new technologies and data analytics tools, always in compliance with applicable regulations.

 

Profile
• At least 3 years of experience as a data architect
• Deep knowledge of data architecture, data and application lifecycle management, CI/CD, and big data technologies
• Experience with Data Lake, Governance and Management
• Strong communication skills, both independently and in a team setting
• Familiar with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, Lean)
• Fluent in either Dutch or French, with at least a basic understanding of the other national language and English
• Analytical mindset, solution-oriented, and eager to keep up with industry trends
• 
Able to coach junior and medior data architects and collaborate across teams

We are looking for a talented and passionate Rust Developer to join our dynamic technical team. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in high-performance software development, with particular expertise in the Rust programming language. You will work on exciting and innovative projects, ranging from designing high-performance tools to building distributed applications, while ensuring security, reliability, and scalability of the systems.

 

Responsibilities:

• Design, develop, and maintain applications using Rust in high-performance environments.
• Collaborate with team members (software engineers, architects, and PMs) to define technical specifications and ensure code quality.
• Write unit, integration, and performance tests to ensure the robustness of the product.
• Participate in code reviews and ensure the quality of the code shared with other team members.
• Optimize application performance by identifying and solving bottlenecks.
• Analyze technical requirements and propose innovative solutions adapted to the company’s needs.
• Maintain clear and comprehensive documentation for code and development processes.
 

Required Skills:

• Strong expertise in Rust with solid experience in building high-performance applications.
• Good knowledge of software architecture, distributed systems, and modern tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
• Experience in memory management and systems programming (thread management, resource handling, etc.).
• Familiarity with agile development practices and associated tools (Git, CI/CD, etc.).
• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently.
• Proficiency in technical English.
Desired Skills:

• Experience with databases (SQL or NoSQL).
• Familiarity with Rust web frameworks (e.g., Actix, Rocket).
• Knowledge of security and cryptography principles in distributed systems.
• Experience with other programming languages such as C, Go, Python, or JavaScript.

We are looking for an AWS Data Engineer with experience in building, monitoring and maintaining reliable and secure data solutions in AWS. You will work closely with Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, and Business Consultants to deliver value to our clients.

 
Your responsibilities
• Build and maintain data infrastructure (e.g. ELT, generic data pipelines, interfaces between data products)
• Translate business needs into well-designed, maintainable data solutions
• Balance cost, performance, and maintainability when designing new or improving on existing solutions
• Implement production-ready solutions (e.g. deployment automation, monitoring, alerting)
• Stay up to date with developments in data technology and share your knowledge with your colleagues
• Coach junior and medior data engineers
 
Your qualifications
Must have

• You have at least 4 years of experience.
• Hands-on experience with implementing data solutions in AWS.
• You can build and maintain infrastructure using Terraform, Bicep, or AWS CloudFormation.
• Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker)
• Hands-on experience with networking, security, and access control in AWS.
• You can set up and maintain deployment automation pipelines and have day-to-day experience with Git (using GitHub, GitLab, or similar)
• You get energy from writing and maintaining clean, well-structured Python code
• You have contributed to production-grade deployments
 

Nice to have

• Hands-on experience with data modeling (Kimball, Data Vault)
• Hands-on experience with container orchestration (ECS/AKS/GKE, Kubernetes)
• Strong analytical SQL skills
• Knowledge of data warehousing best practices
• Hands-on experience with dbt
 

Languages

Fluent in English, and Dutch or French
